doc.state: The state object to be used to control the carousel's state
doc.preferredItemWidth: The width that large, fully visible items would like to be in the horizontal axis. This width is a target and will likely be adjusted by carousel in order to fit a whole number of items within the container. Carousel adjusts small items first (between the [minSmallItemWidth] and [maxSmallItemWidth]) then medium items when present, and finally large items if necessary.
doc.modifier: A modifier instance to be applied to this carousel container
doc.itemSpacing: The amount of space used to separate items in the carousel
doc.flingBehavior: The [TargetedFlingBehavior] to be used for post scroll gestures
doc.flingBehavior.state: The [CarouselState] that controls which Carousel this TargetedFlingBehavior will be applied to.
doc.flingBehavior.snapAnimationSpec: The animation spec used to finally snap to the position.
doc.userScrollEnabled: whether the scrolling via the user gestures or accessibility actions is allowed.
doc.minSmallItemWidth: The minimum allowable width of small items in dp. Depending on the [preferredItemWidth] and the width of the carousel, the small item width will be chosen from a range of [minSmallItemWidth] and [maxSmallItemWidth]
doc.maxSmallItemWidth: The maximum allowable width of small items in dp. Depending on the [preferredItemWidth] and the width of the carousel, the small item width will be chosen from a range of [minSmallItemWidth] and [maxSmallItemWidth]
doc.contentPadding: a padding around the whole content. This will add padding for the content after it has been clipped. You can use it to add a padding before the first item or after the last one. Use [itemSpacing] to add spacing between the items.
